title: Eight fictional requests grouped by HTTP status
method: Synthetic eight-row TSV fixture. Count the status column after validating all rows: 200=5, 404=1, 503=2. Total=8 and 503 share=2/8=25%. Rows represent attempts, not deduplicated customer outcomes. The sample is instructional, not a production measurement.
alt: Eight fictional requests grouped by HTTP status. Illustrative values: HTTP 200 5 attempts, HTTP 404 1 attempts, HTTP 503 2 attempts.
